behaviorChanges: The public upgrade from 0.111.0 removes the former review-round, Stop/completion, board/goal synchronization, and mandatory journal machinery. One adversarial review and the project test gate remain.
Shared work declarations and overlap reports are local and advisory. Evidence receipts wrap explicit verification; no startup hook reruns tests. Inbox answers remain until acknowledged.
New init configurations enable workCoordination. Existing projects opt in or begin declaring work. No cross-machine coordination or automatic answer execution is claimed.

requiredMigrations.description: For projects using the old workflow, preview then apply slim. It archives process artifacts and removes obsolete framework hooks while preserving handwritten instructions. Update handwritten references to removed lane/review commands; use lane-status and work status. Do not rely on the removed gates.

optionalMigrations.description: Set workCoordination=true in a lean project and regenerate its adapters, or start with tautline work declare. This adds local advisory context, not an enforcement gate.

rollbackNotes: Keep the slim migration archive. Downgrading the CLI does not automatically restore old project adapters or hooks; restore the archived configuration deliberately. New work/answer/receipt state is ignored by older versions.
The release test suite exercises installation, upgrade and rollback from public version 0.111.0. This does not restore old gate enforcement after a project has intentionally migrated to lean.
